summary: Bug: bio-helmet prevents fire damage of any sort?

comments.content:
So I'm a toxins researcher, and one thing leads to another and I'm caught
in a fire. 

My biohazard suit melts away, but the bio-helmet doesn't, so I'm free to
just walk around in the flames without taking damage of any sort.

floats != ints apparently

bio hood now burns off (though it probably needs a lower burn point)
